identification: (1) Astor GPN / GPN-A 'Transistor 7' portable radio (Radio Corporation, Melbourne, 1959-64), here in its red leather(ette) carry case with gilt escutcheon, cream woven grille, large round centre dial, small knob top right and leather handle (handle perished/cracked). Matched by design to Terapeak photos of GPN/GPN-A sales (round dial over grille, knob top right, 'ASTOR transistor 7' bar along the bottom; one GPN sold in a brown leather case). (2) Kodak No. 2 Brownie box camera (black leatherette, folding winding key, two brilliant finders, strap handle embossed BROWNIE), probably Model F, 1920s-30s; very common.
